description: Find members and ministers by name, party, constituency and service status. Defaults to the service register; register all includes earlier source records through a larger cold request that may time out. Use numeric memberId with riksdag_get_member for assignment history.

constituency.description: Exact constituency reference label or code, applied locally.

nameContains.description: Strict all-token local name filter, ignoring case and diacritics.

party.description: Party code or exact reference label.

register.description: Register scope; all includes historical records and can require a large cold request that reaches the normal timeout.

revision.description: Revision returned by a preceding page.

sitting.description: Source service classification; all retains unknown status.

name: riksdag_search_members

candidateCount.description: Actual returned candidate records in the selected register scope.

effectiveQuery.description: Deterministic normalized input, applied defaults and local filters.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_filter`: Unknown code or malformed identifier. `revision_changed`: Continuation revision no longer matches. `upstream_identity_mismatch`: Detail identity or filter rows contradict required identity. `upstream_schema_invalid`: Present payload violates wire contract. `upstream_unavailable`: Network or service error after retries. `upstream_queue_full`: Process upstream queue is full. `candidate_limit_reached`: Complete-list safety boundary reached. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

detailAvailable.description: Whether a numeric member IID is published for riksdag_get_member.

memberId.description: Numeric register IID, including leading zeros; absent for some historical and European Parliament entries.

name.description: Published given and family names, when present.

serviceClassification.description: Source-defined Swedish chamber service; unknown is retained.

sourceRecordId.description: Source register UUID, distinct from the member IID.

constituency.description: Exact constituency reference label or code, applied locally.

nameContains.description: Strict all-token local name filter, ignoring case and diacritics.

party.description: Party code or exact reference label.

register.description: Register scope; all includes historical records and can require a large cold request that reaches the normal timeout.

revision.description: Revision returned by a preceding page.

sitting.description: Source service classification; all retains unknown status.

notices.description: All applicable notices, including an empty list.

items.description: A source limitation, applied bound or next-step notice.

requestedLimit.description: Requested row limit before clamping and fitting.

retrievedAt.description: Source fetch time, retained unchanged on cache hits.

source.description: Required attribution to the Swedish Parliament.

sourceReportedCount.description: Source-reported register hits; may differ from actual returned candidates in all scope.

truncated.description: Whether response fitting shortened the selected page.

upstreamQuery.description: Upstream query echo; not proof that a filter was applied.

title: Search parliamentary members
